name: Cocina Familiar
tagline: Desayuno y almuerzo, from 5 in the morning on West Cameron Avenue.
about: Cocina Familiar at 1012 W Cameron Ave in Rockdale serves breakfast and lunch, desayuno y almuerzo, starting at 5 in the morning.
It's listed on the City of Rockdale's Local Eats guide.
conflicts: The menu gives daily hours but not which days the kitchen is closed.
